mapper.select: SELECT ss.id, ss.product_id, p.name AS product_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.image, ''), p.main_image) AS product_image, ss.sku_id, s.spec_info AS sku_spec_info, ss.create_time FROM stock_subscription ss INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = ss.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = ss.sku_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE ss.user_id = #{userId} AND ss.status = 0 ORDER BY ss.create_time DESC, ss.id DESC
